Start with the free Yelp page

Before paying anything, claim your free Yelp business page and fill it in completely: categories, service area, hours, photos and a clear description. Yelp pages often show up in Google results, and AI assistants read review sites when they recommend local businesses. Keep your name, phone and address identical to your Google Business Profile.

Free pages can receive quote requests too. Answer them fast: a request can go to several businesses, and the first good reply usually wins.

How Yelp ads charge

Yelp ads are pay-per-click. You set a monthly budget, and your business appears in sponsored spots in Yelp search results and on other businesses' pages. Yelp also sells page upgrades, such as removing competitor ads from your own page and adding a call-to-action button. Expect sales calls once your page is claimed.

When Yelp ads tend to work

  • Your city has heavy Yelp usage, and people search Yelp for your trade.
  • You already have a strong rating and plenty of recent reviews.
  • You answer quote requests and calls within minutes, every time.
  • Your average job is big enough to absorb the cost of clicks that don't book.

When they usually don't

  • Few people in your area search Yelp for your trade.
  • You have a handful of reviews, or a rating below your competitors'.
  • You can't answer quickly during the workday.
  • You're judging results by clicks or "leads" instead of booked jobs.

A low-risk way to test

  1. Get your free page complete and your reviews in good shape first.
  2. Run a small budget for a set period with a hard monthly cap.
  3. Ask every caller how they found you, and count booked jobs, not clicks.
  4. Divide what you spent by jobs booked. Keep going only if that number works for you.
  5. Get any contract or cancellation terms in writing before you agree.

Our comparison page has a quick calculator for cost per booked job.

The part Yelp can't give you

Your Yelp page is Yelp's page: other businesses can advertise on it unless you pay to remove them, and it lives on Yelp's site. A page of your own, linked from your Google listing, shows only your business and sends every call straight to you.

Common questions

Are Yelp ads worth it for contractors?: common questions

Are Yelp ads worth it for contractors?

They can be in cities and trades where people search Yelp heavily, and when you answer leads within minutes. Test with a small capped budget and judge it on cost per booked job, not clicks.

How does Yelp advertising charge?

Yelp ads are pay-per-click: you set a monthly budget and pay when someone clicks your ad. Yelp also sells page upgrades, such as removing competitor ads from your page.

Is a free Yelp business page worth having?

Yes. A claimed, complete Yelp page can show up in Google results, can receive quote requests, and is one of the sources AI assistants read. Keep its details identical to your Google Business Profile.

Why do competitor ads show on my Yelp page?

Yelp sells ad placements that can appear on other businesses' pages. Removing them from your own page is a paid upgrade.
